title: Kong AI Gateway 2.0 reaches general availability
summary: The production-supported release reduces product-execution risk around Kong's AI-control-plane strategy. It strengthens the product-position score, while valuation inputs remain unchanged until commercial traction or financial contribution is disclosed.
confirmed: Kong says AI Gateway 2.0 is generally available and production-supported in Konnect with its own runtime and control plane.

The release adds MCP Server Bundling with per-caller tool visibility, modality-aware cost governance, Kong Identity principals, expanded model-provider support, and native AWS IAM authentication for Amazon Bedrock AgentCore.
uncertain: Kong did not disclose customer adoption, bookings, incremental ARR, pricing, margins, or financial contribution.
The pace of customer migration from existing Gateway AI plugins to the standalone product is unknown.
